parts.name: Questions 1-2 · Read a Text Aloud
parts.dir: 화면의 지문을 소리 내어 읽습니다. 준비 45초, 답변 45초.

items.text: Good morning, passengers, and welcome aboard the Harbor Line express service to Westbury. Our next stops will be Maple Junction, Riverside Park, and Kensington Station. Please note that the café car is now open and offers sandwiches, fresh salads, and hot drinks. Passengers traveling with bicycles should use the storage area at the rear of the train. We expect to arrive in Westbury on schedule at ten forty-five. Thank you for traveling with us.
items.q: Read the text on the screen aloud.

say.t: Question 1. In this part of the test, you will read aloud the text on the screen. You will have 45 seconds to prepare. Then you will have 45 seconds to read the text aloud.

items.model: (Read the text aloud with natural pauses.) Good morning, passengers, / and welcome aboard the Harbor Line express service to Westbury. // Our next stops will be Maple Junction, ↗ Riverside Park, ↗ and Kensington Station. ↘ // Please note / that the café car is now open / and offers sandwiches, ↗ fresh salads, ↗ and hot drinks. ↘ // Passengers traveling with bicycles / should use the storage area / at the rear of the train. // We expect to arrive in Westbury on schedule / at ten forty-five. // Thank you for traveling with us.
items.tip:
열거(A, B, and C)는 앞 두 개를 올리고(↗) 마지막을 내린다(↘) — 채점관이 가장 먼저 보는 억양 포인트.
고유명사(Maple Junction, Kensington)는 준비 45초 동안 강세 위치를 정해 두고 머뭇거리지 말 것.
'café', 'rear', 'forty-five' 발음을 또박또박. 다 읽고 시간이 남아도 다시 읽지 않는다.

items.text: Are you looking for an easier way to charge your electric vehicle? At VoltPoint Charging Hubs, we make it simple. Our new locations in Dunmore, Ashford, and Clearwater offer fast chargers, comfortable waiting lounges, and free wireless internet. Just scan the QR code at any station to reserve a time slot in advance. Sign up for a monthly membership this week, and your first three charges will be completely free.
items.q: Read the text on the screen aloud.

say.t: Question 2. You will have 45 seconds to prepare. Then you will have 45 seconds to read the text aloud.

items.model: (Read the text aloud with natural pauses.) Are you looking for an easier way / to charge your electric vehicle? ↗ // At VoltPoint Charging Hubs, / we make it simple. // Our new locations in Dunmore, ↗ Ashford, ↗ and Clearwater ↘ / offer fast chargers, ↗ comfortable waiting lounges, ↗ and free wireless internet. ↘ // Just scan the QR code at any station / to reserve a time slot in advance. // Sign up for a monthly membership this week, / and your first three charges / will be completely FREE.
items.tip:
광고문은 첫 질문문을 밝고 힘 있게 — 'Are you looking ~?'는 Yes/No 의문문이라 끝을 올린다.
열거가 두 번 나온다(지명 3개, 시설 3개). 주어가 길어지는 'Our new locations in ~ Clearwater' 뒤에서 한 번 끊고 동사 offer로 넘어갈 것.
'QR code'는 '큐알'이 아니라 [kjuː ɑːr], 마지막 'completely free'에 강세를 주어 광고 느낌을 살린다.

parts.name: Questions 3-4 · Describe a Picture
parts.dir: 화면의 사진을 가능한 한 자세히 묘사합니다. 준비 45초, 답변 30초.

items.q: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as you can.

say.t: Question 3. In this part of the test, you will describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as you can. You will have 45 seconds to prepare your response. Then you will have 30 seconds to speak about the picture.

items.model: This picture seems to have been taken in a study room or a small classroom. The first thing I notice is a young man in a hooded jacket and a female instructor sitting side by side at a desk. They are looking at a book together, and it looks like she is explaining something to him. In front of them, there is a laptop computer and some papers spread out on the desk. On one side, I can see a desk lamp that is turned on. Overall, it looks like a one-on-one tutoring session, and the student seems to be concentrating hard.
items.tip:
장소 → 가장 눈에 띄는 사람(동작+옷차림) → 주변 사물(위치 표현) → 느낌 한 줄 순서로 30초를 채운다.
'side by side', 'spread out on the desk', 'in front of them' 같은 위치 표현을 2개 이상 넣으면 점수가 오른다.
보이지 않는 것은 단정하지 말고 'It looks like / seems to' 로 추측 표현을 쓸 것.

items.q: Describe the picture on your screen in as much detail as you can.

say.t: Question 4. You will have 45 seconds to prepare your response. Then you will have 30 seconds to speak about the picture.

items.model: This is a picture of a group of people gathered in what looks like a lounge or a common room. Several people are sitting close together on a sofa, and they are all holding sheets of paper, maybe handouts. They are smiling and laughing, so they must be sharing something funny or enjoying a casual meeting. In the foreground, there is a low table with a few cups on it. Generally speaking, the atmosphere looks very relaxed and friendly, like a study group or a team taking a break together.
items.tip:
여러 명이 나오는 사진은 한 명씩 묘사하지 말고 '공통 동작(sitting / holding / laughing)'으로 묶는다.
'In the foreground(앞쪽)'로 테이블과 컵을 짚어 공간 묘사를 보충할 것.
마지막에 분위기 한 문장(relaxed and friendly)으로 마무리하면 30초가 자연스럽게 끝난다.

parts.name: Questions 5-7 · Respond to Questions
parts.dir: 전화 설문에 답하는 상황입니다. 질문마다 준비 3초, 답변 15·15·30초.

items.q: How many subscription services do you currently pay for, and what kinds of services are they?

say.t: Questions 5 through 7. In this part of the test, you will answer three questions. You will have three seconds to prepare after you hear each question. You will have 15 seconds to respond to Questions 5 and 6, and 30 seconds to respond to Question 7.
Imagine that a market research company is conducting a telephone survey in your area. You have agreed to participate in a telephone interview about subscription services.
How many subscription services do you currently pay for, and what kinds of services are they?

items.model: Right now I pay for three subscription services. Two of them are video streaming services that I watch with my family, and the other one is a cloud storage service I use for my work files.
items.tip:
질문의 두 요소(몇 개 + 어떤 종류)를 첫 문장에 바로 답한다 — 'Right now I pay for three ~'.
15초는 2문장이면 충분. 숫자와 종류만 정확히 말하고 이유는 짧게.

items.q: When was the last time you signed up for a new subscription service, and what was it?

say.t: When was the last time you signed up for a new subscription service, and what was it?

items.model: The last time I signed up for a new subscription was about two months ago. It was a meal-kit delivery service, because I wanted to cook healthier dinners on busy weekdays.
items.tip:
과거 질문이므로 시제를 과거로 통일(signed up, was, wanted). 'about two months ago'처럼 구체적 시점을 넣는다.
'what was it'에 대한 답 뒤에 because 한 줄로 이유를 붙이면 15초가 깔끔하게 끝난다.

items.q: In your opinion, what is the biggest disadvantage of paying for subscription services? Why?

say.t: In your opinion, what is the biggest disadvantage of paying for subscription services? Why?

items.model: In my opinion, the biggest disadvantage is that it's easy to forget how much you're actually spending. Since the payments are automatic, people often keep paying for services they hardly use anymore. For example, last year I found out I had been paying for a music app for six months without opening it once. So I think subscriptions can quietly waste a lot of money unless you check them regularly.
items.tip:
의견(In my opinion) → 이유 → 예시(For example) → 결론(So I think) 4단 구조로 30초를 채운다.
자기 경험 예시 하나가 점수를 크게 올린다. 너무 거창한 사회 문제보다 생활 속 사례로.

parts.name: Questions 8-10 · Respond to Questions Using Information Provided
parts.dir: 표를 45초 동안 읽은 뒤, 문의 전화에 표 정보로 답합니다. 준비 3초, 답변 15·15·30초. 10번 질문은 두 번 들려줍니다.

say.t: Questions 8 through 10. In this part of the test, you will answer three questions based on the information provided. You will have 45 seconds to read the information before the questions begin. You will have three seconds to prepare and 15 seconds to respond to Questions 8 and 9. You will hear Question 10 two times. You will have three seconds to prepare and 30 seconds to respond to Question 10.
Hi, this is Jordan Pak from the marketing team. I signed up for the training day next month, but I deleted the e-mail with the schedule by mistake. I hope you can help me with a few questions.
First, what is the date of the training day, and where will it be held?

items.model: Sure, Jordan. The training day is on Thursday, November 12th, and it will be held in Room 204 at the Lakeview Conference Center. Registration starts at 9 A.M.
items.tip:
표 맨 위(제목·날짜·장소·비용)는 Q8에 거의 반드시 나온다 — 45초 읽기 시간에 먼저 확인.
날짜는 'on Thursday, November 12th', 장소는 'in Room 204 at ~'처럼 전치사까지 정확히. 시작 시각 한 줄을 덧붙이면 친절한 답변이 된다.

제목은 그대로 읽기보다 'a lecture on ~ing'처럼 문장으로 풀어 말하면 자연스럽다. 질문은 두 번 나오니 첫 번째에 이름만 정확히 잡을 것.

parts.name: Question 11 · Express an Opinion
parts.dir: 주어진 주제에 대해 의견과 이유·예시를 말합니다. 준비 45초, 답변 60초.

items.q: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Companies should allow employees to work from home at least two days a week. Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.

say.t: Question 11. In this part of the test, you will give your opinion about a specific topic. Be sure to say as much as you can in the time allowed. You will have 45 seconds to prepare. Then you will have 60 seconds to speak.
Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Companies should allow employees to work from home at least two days a week. Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.

items.model: I agree that companies should allow employees to work from home at least two days a week, for two main reasons. First, it saves employees a lot of time and energy. For example, my friend used to spend almost two hours a day commuting, but now that she works from home twice a week, she uses that time to exercise and rest, and she says she's much more productive. Second, a hybrid schedule can actually improve focus. At the office, people are often interrupted by phone calls and short chats, but at home they can concentrate on tasks that need deep thinking. Of course, face-to-face meetings are still important, so I think keeping three office days is a good balance. For these reasons, I strongly believe a two-day remote work policy benefits both workers and companies.
items.tip:
입장(I agree) → 이유1+구체 예시 → 이유2+대조 → 반대 의견 한 줄 인정 → 결론 반복. 60초에 이 틀이 딱 맞는다.
2026 경향 주제(재택·하이브리드·AI 도입)는 예시를 미리 1~2개 준비해 두면 어느 문제에도 재활용 가능.
준비 45초에는 문장이 아니라 키워드(commute 2h / focus / balance)만 메모.
